correctness.rationale: The full binary branch coding of the piecewise slope-2 map is a fair Bernoulli itinerary. Exactly the two length-m cylinders flanking 1/2 form the hole; adjacent-symbol equality bits give a 2-to-1 reduction to avoiding the single word 1 followed by m-2 zeros. Last-one decomposition yields b_{r,l}=1+sum_{j=1}^r b_{r,l-j}, including r=0; from t+m-1 cylinders derive P(tau>=t)=b_{r,t+r}/2^(t+r), r=m-2. Generating function at 1/2 and subtraction of first r+1 unconstrained lengths yields E tau=2^(m-1)-m+1. Perron root gives escape log(2/lambda_m), entropy log(lambda_m) and dimension log(lambda_m)/log2 for m>=4; r<=1 has entropy zero. Small-hole expansion follows (2-lambda)*lambda^r=1. Null precritical boundary points do not change Lebesgue results. Finite independent direct counts for m=2..7,t=1..6 corroborated but did not supply the infinite proof.
